decision.summary: A correlated multi-sample offset is observed in N and E from index 514 onward, with U showing a faster-recovering transient dip. The asymmetric recovery (U rebounds by ~520 while N/E remain depressed through 523) prevents confirmation of a complete temporary interval; the return phase is incomplete within allowed context [475,560], hence status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are evident in the allowed context.
